requirements.text: Minimum experience: 4+ years of research or industry experience in experimental or computational materials science and working with data at scale.
Minimum education: PhD in Materials Science, Chemistry, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.

This role requires domain depth, not just data engineering skill. You need to know, for example, what metadata actually matters for a given characterization technique. The research half of the role keeps you grounded in the problems we are actually using LLMs to solve, so the schemas you build serve real research rather than an abstraction of it.
